comment: The section appropriately presents interoperability as a property of the architecture, but the phrase “no single system can hold all of this, and none should attempt to” is too absolute. Some national or institutional platforms may legitimately consolidate broad datasets while remaining interoperable and well governed.

public.text: The section appropriately presents interoperability as a property of the architecture, but the phrase “no single system can hold all of this, and none should attempt to” is too absolute. Some national or institutional platforms may legitimately consolidate broad datasets while remaining interoperable and well governed.
public.suggestedRevision: Qualify the statement: “No single system should be assumed to hold or control all relevant health information. Countries may consolidate selected datasets where justified, while preserving interoperability, proportionality, data rights, resilience, and clear governance.”
